app.title: HeatSafe
app.tagline: Find the safest way to walk through extreme heat in central Santa Ana.

why.title: Why? See the data
why.heatMethod: "Feels like" adds up to 15°F to the heat index for time in full sun (National Weather Service guidance). Shade comes from building and tree heights and the sun's position at that time.
map.noKey: Map key missing: showing basic OpenStreetMap tiles. Satellite view needs VITE_MAPTILER_KEY.
error.network: Couldn't reach the HeatSafe server. Make sure the backend is running, then try again.

walk3d.unavailable: 3D street view is unavailable (needs a Google Maps key and a larger screen). The map above still shows the walk.
walk3d.credit: 3D buildings and trees: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles. Shadows drawn for the trip's date and time.
later.title: Leave later?
nosafe.title: Every route is rated Extreme right now.
nosafe.noBetter: No route gets below Extreme before 8 PM.
nosafe.bus: Or take the bus for more of the trip:
nosafe.exhaustion: Heat exhaustion: heavy sweating, cold or clammy skin, dizziness, nausea, weakness. Move somewhere cool, loosen clothing, sip water.
nosafe.stroke: Heat stroke: very high body temperature, hot red skin, confusion, fainting. Call 911 right away; cool the person down while you wait.
map.keyFailed: The map service didn't accept the MapTiler key: showing basic OpenStreetMap tiles instead. Check VITE_MAPTILER_KEY.
form.planSentence: Compare routes by how much shade they have at the time you'll walk.
footer.built: Built for the 2026 Congressional App Challenge.
how.title: How heat exposure is rated
how.body: Each route's feels-like temperature is the heat index plus up to 15°F for the share walked in direct sun, following National Weather Service guidance.
map.hint: Hover a route to compare. Click one to choose it.

card.whyAi: Reason written by AI from the measured routes; every number in it is checked.
card.whyRule: Picked by a simple rule: lowest heat exposure, then least time in sun.
